sources.title: Kaspersky - Carbanak APT: The Great Bank Robbery
sources.what_it_gave: real Carbanak campaign (2013-2016) against financial institutions the emulation models

narrative_before: This is a documented CTID emulation of Carbanak, modelling the real Carbanak APT campaign (~2013-2016) that stole from financial institutions (Kaspersky). The emulation targets a four-host bank domain: domain controller 'bankdc', HR manager workstation 'hrmanager', CFO workstation 'cfo', and Linux 'bankfileserver'. A spearphishing RTF compromises hrmanager, where the actor deploys a RAT, takes screenshots, injects a second-stage RAT via shellcode in the registry, and escalates privileges with a modified Mimikatz. The actor uploads tools and uses plink.exe to SSH into bankfileserver, where files reveal information to target the CFO, then uses impacket psexec with a domain-admin NTLM hash to move from bankfileserver to bankdc. From bankdc the actor profiles and RDPs to the cfo workstation, deploys a keylogger and VNC, and impersonates the CFO user to complete the fraud.

detection_moments.description: Initial breach: spearphishing RTF on hrmanager; RAT deployed and second-stage shellcode injected.
detection_moments.evidence: 'a legitimate user executing a malicious payload delivered via spearphishing ... write obfuscated shellcode to the Windows Registry ... injects the shellcode into the current PowerShell process' - Carbanak Operations Flow / Scenario 1

detection_moments.description: Privilege escalation (modified Mimikatz) on hrmanager; SSH via plink into bankfileserver to read targeting files.
detection_moments.evidence: 'use plink.exe to SSH into bankfileserver ... browse local files. The contents of two files ... provide them with information needed to target the CFO' - Carbanak Scenario 1 Step 5

detection_moments.description: impacket psexec with the DA hash from bankfileserver to bankdc, then RDP from bankdc to the cfo workstation.
detection_moments.evidence: './runtime psexec.py ...@<bankdc_ip> -hashes <...> ... RDP into CFO as <cfo_user>' - Carbanak Scenario 1 Steps 5-8

attack_path: plink.exe SSH from hrmanager to Linux bankfileserver - T1021.004
impacket psexec pass-the-hash from bankfileserver to bankdc - T1021.002 / T1550.002 / T1569.002
RDP from bankdc to the CFO workstation - T1021.001
ambiguities: Documented emulation of the real Carbanak campaign (~2013-2016); year 2015 chosen as a representative campaign year.
Hostnames (bankdc/hrmanager/cfo/bankfileserver) are the plan's lab names, not a specific real victim's.
'money_processing' service value 25 reflects the plan's financial-institution objective (fraud via the CFO).
